result.stdout:
Bielu.Arazzo.Cli - Validate, lint, and diff Arazzo workflow documents

Usage: dotnet arazzo <command> [options]

Commands:
  validate       Validate Arazzo documents (structural invariants)
  lint           Lint Arazzo documents (style and graph-shape checks)
  diff           Compare two Arazzo documents for changes

validate/lint options:
  --file <path>            Path or glob to Arazzo document(s) (required, repeatable)
  --strict                 Treat warnings as errors
  --format <text|json>     Output format (default: text)

diff options:
  --base <path>            Path to the base (old) Arazzo document (required)
  --head <path>            Path to the head (new) Arazzo document (required)
  --fail-on-breaking       Exit with code 1 if breaking changes are detected
  --format <text|json|markdown> Output format (default: text)

  -h, --help               Show this help message
